Messages.Author: Khormag
Messages.Body:
European Grand Prix: Hyvinkää
Hyvinkää, Finland
June 11, 2022
3R + F
25 Players
Noora Hirvonen
Event Calendar

Sunny day at the venue, Hyvikää Villatehdas, opened up with a nice surprise of 25 participants and even some friends from Sweden and Belgium. Games were tight and bloody, but the atmosphere was fantastic.

Big thanks to everyone who participated and also to Hypecon staff for hosting us and being very helpful with everything!

Finals Seating:
Magnus Söder (Ravnos Week of Nightmares) --> Tommi Hakomaa (Jost/Rebekka) --> Aapo Järvelin (The Capuchin Wall) --> Bram Van Stappen (Matasuntha & Company Wall) --> Noora Hirvonen (Girls will find Inner Circles)

Messages.Author: cordovader
Messages.Body:
I am really surprised to see Noora winning with the seating of this finals. Did someone manage to convince the wall decks to block the clown car deck cross-table? If not it's difficult for me to understand how can you damage enough the clown car deck to manage and oust it.

In any case, congrats to Noora, it does not seam like an easy finals (with Bram playing Matasuntha as a predator).

Smoking craters tell no tales.
—Tex talks Battletech
